summary: Integration brief: Agent Loop proposes and coordinates autonomous work; Tool Gate independently evaluates proposed tool invocations and emits deterministic allow, deny, or review_required receipts without executing them. Their shared safety boundary is the separation of agent intent from runtime authority: an agent may propose an action, but execution must depend on explicit policy and auditable evidence. Actionable integration: require every Agent Loop tool proposal to become a ToolMetadata plus InvocationEnvelope request, then permit the runtime to execute only an allow receipt while routing review_required to an operator and logging deny. Agent Loop risk: proposals could bypass governance if any runtime path executes them without consulting Tool Gate. Tool Gate risk: allowed-target matching accepts unrestricted '*' and simple trailing-prefix wildcards, so overly broad or malformed catalog policy can authorize unintended targets; it also is not a sandbox or authentication layer. The declared clean-tree check passed, and no files were modified.
